# OctoProbe AI

> Multi-source network intelligence platform for investigators, law firms, OSINT practitioners, and opposition research teams.

OctoProbe AI performs multi-hop entity resolution across identity databases, breach intelligence, open-source data, dark web archives, and proprietary data lakes. Starting from any identifier — name, email, phone, address — OctoProbe maps every connected entity across all integrated sources into a unified investigation graph.

## Key capabilities

- **Multi-hop analysis**: Traverse entity connections 1–3+ hops deep across all integrated data sources simultaneously
- **Entity resolution**: Deduplicate and confidence-score conflicting records across sources
- **MCP server**: Exposes investigation tools as callable functions for any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude Desktop, etc.)
- **REST API**: Full programmatic access for automation and platform integration
- **Custom data connectors**: Ingest proprietary databases, case files, or internal data lakes
- **Breach intelligence**: Cross-reference identifiers against credential and breach databases
- **Social footprint mapping**: Platform presence, alias clustering, username correlation
- **Dark web archive search**: Index and archive correlation
- **Public records**: Corporate filings, UCC records, property, aviation, maritime, and more
- **Audit logging**: Every query, expansion, and export logged to the authenticated user
- **Court-ready exports**: Timestamped, source-attributed PDF, JSON, and CSV

## Who uses OctoProbe

- Law firms conducting due diligence, asset tracing, and litigation support
- Licensed private investigators and investigative agencies
- OSINT practitioners and analysts
- Opposition research and political intelligence firms
- Corporate security and intelligence teams
- Investigative newsrooms

## Integration

OctoProbe runs a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, making all investigation capabilities callable from any MCP-compatible AI client. Analysts can run natural-language investigation workflows in Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any other MCP host while OctoProbe handles data queries, graph traversal, and result normalization behind the scenes.
